item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy,json\\nfrom work import evaluate\\nwith open('policy.json') as f: p=json.load(f)\\nwith open('requests.json') as f: rs=json.load(f)\\nwith open('report.json') as f: report=json.load(f)\\nexpected=[evaluate(r,p) for r in rs]\\nassert report==expected\\nfor r in rs:\\n rb=copy.deepcopy(r); pb=copy.deepcopy(p); evaluate(r,p); assert r==rb and p==pb\\nassert evaluate({'from':'x','to':'y'},p)=={'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'blocked'}\\nassert evaluate({'from':'ready','to':'running','role':'wrong','retry':True,'attempts':0},p)=={'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'permission'}\\nfor bad in [None,True,False,-1,2,3,1.0,'1']:\\n assert evaluate({'from':'failed','to':'ready','retry':True,'attempts':bad},p)=={'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}, bad\\nfor good in [0,1]:\\n assert evaluate({'from':'failed','to':'ready','retry':True,'attempts':good},p)=={'ok':True,'value':'ready','reason':'ok'}\\nassert evaluate({'from':'failed','to':'ready'},p)=={'ok':True,'value':'ready','reason':'ok'}\\nprint('all checks passed')\"]}"}
